pages.text: You may notice that some enchantments have different colored names.$(p)This is because Apotheosis introduces three new sub-categories of enchantments.$(p)Each sub-category shares a theme.

pages.title: Masterwork
pages.text: $(2)Masterwork$() enchantments represent the strongest and rarest enchantments.$(p)They typically require a high $(fpower) to receive.

pages.title: Twisted
pages.text: $(5)Twisted$() enchantments always have one good and one bad effect.

pages.title: Corrupted
pages.text: $(4)Corrupted$() enchantments have a health cost associated with their effect.$(p)They are considered to be $(c)curses$().
